text:
The median asking rent in Dortmund sits at 9.7 €/m², up 2.4 % year‑on‑year and 23.2 % over the last five years, placing the city 29th of the 37 most expensive German markets. The 25th‑percentile is 8.4 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 11.19 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 582 € per month.

Market tightness is evident: listings spend only 33 days on market, with 22 % let within a week, and vacancy stands at 2.1 %. Rent‑burden for two residents is 14.4 %, and asking rents command a 50 % premium over the 2022 census existing rent of 6.45 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.31 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.02 €/m² and 10.52 €/m², implying a 6.2 % increase.
